newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radical Palestinians protest settlement building.
newsitem.headline: Radical Palestinians protest settlement building.

text.p: Radical Palestinian groups on Thursday staged a demonstration at the Yarmouk refugee camp near Damascus to protest the building of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

The protesters, including representatives of Palestinian groups which oppose peace with Israel, marched through the streets of the camp carrying Palestinian flags and shouting slogans condemning Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

"Netanyahu's decision to build a settlement at Jabal Abu Ghneim is a challenge to the Arab nation and the international community...practical actions and not words are needed to stop the aggression against Arab land," Talal Naji of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command (PFLP-GC) told the rally.
Naji accused Palestinian President Yasser Arafat of cooperating with Israel "to repress Palestinian masses and prevent them from confronting the Israeli bulldozers."
Palestinian demonstrators burned the Israeli flag before dispersing peacefully.
Israel began work on Tuesday to build 6,500 homes at a site in Arab East Jerusalem with bulldozers ploughing up the hill of Jabal abu Ghneim which is called Har Homa by Israel.
